summary: Iteration 153: Team Pins (NOC Strip) feature fully tested. All 14 backend tests passed. Frontend verified: TeamPinsStrip component on Dashboard shows team-pinned tickets with red pulsing stripe, 'TEAM PINNED · NOC STRIP' header, count badge, and ticket cards. Ticket detail shows red 'TEAM' badge with Siren icon when team-pinned. Actions menu has 'Pin for Team (NOC strip)' / 'Unpin from Team' option. Existing flows (workspace, personal pin, C.R.A.I.G, Actions, Billing) all working.
critical_code_review_comments: Team pins router properly implements 4 endpoints: list, pin, unpin, status
Permission logic correct: any auth'd user can pin, only original pinner or admin can unpin
Hydration in GET /api/team-pins returns ticket details (priority, status, client_name, etc.)
All data-testid attributes present: team-pins-strip, team-pin-{id}, team-unpin-{id}, team-pinned-badge, actions-team-pin
seed_data_creation: Test tickets created and cleaned up during backend tests. Existing team pins (INC-0003, INC-0008) used for frontend verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Team Pins feature at /api/team-pins fully functional. TeamPinsStrip component on Dashboard shows when there are active team pins. Ticket detail Actions menu has 'Pin for Team (NOC strip)' / 'Unpin from Team' option. Red pulsing 'TEAM' badge appears in ticket header when team-pinned. Personal workspace pins (/workspace) work independently of team pins.
